checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same person, curly dark hair retained
must.why: Face, features and curls match closely.
Navy blazer over a navy top.
Park replaced by smooth light grey with a slight gradient.

must.item: Centred head-and-shoulders, full top of hair visible
must.why: Centred, with the hair top visible and a small margin above.

must.item: Natural lighting and skin, no artifacts
must.why: Looks natural; the skin is slightly smoothed and the hair edges are clean.

faults.what: Skin is slightly smoothed/retouched and the face is a little brighter than the original; the blazer collar is a bit flat.

summary: A clean, square LinkedIn headshot that keeps the same face and curls, with a navy blazer and plain light grey background, and no notable problems.
